widgets.text: Watch three resources in the game HUD: armor (lost to hits), fuel (runs down all the time) and ammo for each weapon. Fuel drums and armor/ammo crates refill them.

widgets.label: Arsenal
rows: Unlimited-ish, weak: soldiers and light vehicles
Heavy: tanks, radar, buildings; save them
Hover over people and crates to pick them up

widgets.text: Kill anti-aircraft guns and missile launchers first; circle-strafe tanks so their turrets can't track you. Never hover in place near enemy fire.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Each campaign is a set of numbered objectives on a big map (radar, power plants, POWs, enemy commanders). Do them in order; the map screen shows the next one.
Fuel drums, ammo crates and armor repair crates sit on the map; landing zones refill and drop off rescued people.
POWs and MIAs give bonus points and sometimes extra lives when delivered to a landing zone.
Campaigns end with a passcode screen; write it down to continue later.
